ideas.pitch: A decentralized peer-to-peer micro-lending and emergency fund platform built specifically for college students facing sudden cash flow gaps.
ideas.title: CampusCrone
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a real hyper-local pain point for undergraduate students living away from home, making it immediately relatable to IIM Indore judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered food waste and nutritional tracker for institutional messes that predicts daily student turnout using historical patterns and dietary preferences.
ideas.title: MessMeter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines sustainability with severe cost-saving potential for hostel and campus management, addressing a problem every judge experiences daily.

ideas.pitch: An algorithmic project-teaming platform that matches students across different colleges based on complementary technical stacks, past hackathon repos, and working hours.
ideas.title: SkillSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the cross-college collaboration aspect permitted in the event rules, making it a meta-solution for future hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A knowledge graph generator that transforms chaotic lecture PDFs and handwritten notes into structured interactive revision mind-maps using local LLMs.
ideas.title: StudyGraph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the universal student struggle of information overload right before exams with a highly visual, working product demonstration.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first rapid ticketing and attendance verification app utilizing localized cryptography and QR rotation to prevent proxy check-ins at college fests.
ideas.title: EventPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers genuine systems engineering and solves a logistical nightmare familiar to event organizers at IIM Indore.
